name: node-canvas
title: Node Canvas
description: A pannable, zoomable node canvas with draggable nodes, live bezier edges, selection handles, a minimap, a zoom control and multiplayer cursors.

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
  import type { NodeCanvasBarsProps } from './types';

  const props = withDefaults(defineProps<NodeCanvasBarsProps>(), {
    class: '',
  });

  const WIDTH = 200;
  const HEIGHT = 64;
  const GAP = 4.5;
  const SEGMENT_GAP = 1.5;

  const hovered = ref<number | null>(null);

  const max = computed(() =>
    Math.max(
      1,
      ...props.bars.map((bar) =>
        bar.reduce((sum, segment) => sum + segment.value, 0),
      ),
    ),
  );

  const columns = computed(() => {
    const count = Math.max(1, props.bars.length);
    const barWidth = (WIDTH - GAP * (count - 1)) / count;
    return props.bars.map((bar, i) => {
      const total = bar.reduce((sum, segment) => sum + segment.value, 0);
      let y = HEIGHT;
      const rects = bar.map((segment, j) => {
        const h = Math.max(
          1.5,
          (segment.value / max.value) * HEIGHT - SEGMENT_GAP,
        );
        y -= h + (j === 0 ? 0 : SEGMENT_GAP);
        return { key: j, y, height: h, color: segment.color };
      });
      return {
        index: i,
        x: i * (barWidth + GAP),
        width: barWidth,
        total,
        rects,
      };
    });
  });

  function onEnter(index: number): void {
    hovered.value = index;
  }

  function onLeave(): void {
    hovered.value = null;
  }
</script>

<template>
  <svg
    role="img"
    :aria-label="props.label"
    :viewBox="`0 0 ${WIDTH} ${HEIGHT}`"
    preserveAspectRatio="none"
    :class="['block size-full overflow-visible', props.class]"
  >
    <g
      v-for="column in columns"
      :key="column.index"
      :data-bar="column.index"
      class="transition-opacity"
      :opacity="hovered === null || hovered === column.index ? 1 : 0.35"
      @pointerenter="onEnter(column.index)"
      @pointerleave="onLeave"
    >
      <title>{{ `Hour ${column.index + 1}: ${column.total} stops` }}</title>
      <rect
        :x="column.x"
        y="0"
        :width="column.width"
        :height="HEIGHT"
        fill="transparent"
      />
      <rect
        v-for="rect in column.rects"
        :key="rect.key"
        :x="column.x"
        :y="rect.y"
        :width="column.width"
        :height="rect.height"
        rx="1.5"
        :fill="rect.color"
      />
    </g>
  </svg>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { useId } from 'vue';
  import type { NodeCanvasEdgesProps } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<NodeCanvasEdgesProps>();

  const uid = useId();
  const solidMarker = `${uid}-arrow-solid`;
  const dashedMarker = `${uid}-arrow-dashed`;

  function markerFor(variant: string, arrow: boolean): string | undefined {
    if (!arrow) return undefined;
    return `url(#${variant === 'solid' ? solidMarker : dashedMarker})`;
  }
</script>

<template>
  <svg
    aria-hidden="true"
    class="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 size-px overflow-visible"
  >
    <defs>
      <marker
        :id="solidMarker"
        viewBox="0 0 10 10"
        refX="9"
        refY="5"
        markerWidth="7"
        markerHeight="7"
        orient="auto-start-reverse"
        class="text-blue-500"
      >
        <path
          d="M 1 1 L 9 5 L 1 9"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="1.6"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
        />
      </marker>
      <marker
        :id="dashedMarker"
        viewBox="0 0 10 10"
        refX="9"
        refY="5"
        markerWidth="7"
        markerHeight="7"
        orient="auto-start-reverse"
        class="text-muted-foreground"
      >
        <path
          d="M 1 1 L 9 5 L 1 9"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="1.6"
          stroke-linecap="round"
          stroke-linejoin="round"
        />
      </marker>
    </defs>
    <g v-for="edge in props.paths" :key="edge.id" :data-edge-id="edge.id">
      <path
        :d="edge.d"
        fill="none"
        :class="
          edge.variant === 'solid'
            ? 'stroke-blue-500'
            : 'stroke-muted-foreground/70'
        "
        :stroke-width="edge.variant === 'solid' ? 1.75 : 1.4"
        :stroke-dasharray="edge.variant === 'dashed' ? '4 4' : undefined"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        :marker-end="markerFor(edge.variant, edge.arrow)"
      />
      <circle
        v-if="!edge.arrow"
        :cx="edge.end.x"
        :cy="edge.end.y"
        r="3"
        :class="
          edge.variant === 'solid'
            ? 'fill-blue-500'
            : 'fill-muted-foreground/80'
        "
      />
    </g>
  </svg>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
  import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
  import { unionRect } from './node-canvas-geometry';
  import type {
    NodeCanvasMinimapProps,
    NodeCanvasPoint,
    NodeCanvasRect,
  } from './types';

  const props = defineProps<NodeCanvasMinimapProps>();

  const emit = defineEmits<{ navigate: [point: NodeCanvasPoint] }>();

  const WIDTH = 64;
  const HEIGHT = 40;
  const PAD = 4;

  const bounds = computed(() => unionRect([...props.items, props.viewport]));

  const scale = computed(() =>
    Math.min(
      (WIDTH - PAD * 2) / bounds.value.width,
      (HEIGHT - PAD * 2) / bounds.value.height,
    ),
  );

  const offset = computed(() => ({
    x: (WIDTH - bounds.value.width * scale.value) / 2,
    y: (HEIGHT - bounds.value.height * scale.value) / 2,
  }));

  function project(rect: NodeCanvasRect): NodeCanvasRect {
    return {
      x: offset.value.x + (rect.x - bounds.value.x) * scale.value,
      y: offset.value.y + (rect.y - bounds.value.y) * scale.value,
      width: Math.max(2, rect.width * scale.value),
      height: Math.max(2, rect.height * scale.value),
    };
  }

  const frame = computed(() => project(props.viewport));

  const svg = useTemplateRef<SVGSVGElement>('svg');

  function onClick(event: MouseEvent): void {
    const box = svg.value?.getBoundingClientRect();
    // Keyboard activation has no pointer position: recenter on all nodes.
    if (!box || event.detail === 0) {
      const nodes = unionRect(props.items);
      emit('navigate', {
        x: nodes.x + nodes.width / 2,
        y: nodes.y + nodes.height / 2,
      });
      return;
    }
    const sx = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width) * WIDTH;
    const sy = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height) * HEIGHT;
    emit('navigate', {
      x: bounds.value.x + (sx - offset.value.x) / scale.value,
      y: bounds.value.y + (sy - offset.value.y) / scale.value,
    });
  }
</script>

<template>
  <button
    type="button"
    aria-label="Minimap. Click to move the view."
    class="block rounded-xl border bg-card/95 p-1 shadow-lg backdrop-blur-sm focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
    @pointerdown.stop
    @click="onClick"
  >
    <svg ref="svg" :viewBox="`0 0 ${WIDTH} ${HEIGHT}`" class="block h-10 w-16">
      <rect
        v-for="item in props.items"
        :key="item.id"
        :data-minimap-id="item.id"
        v-bind="project(item)"
        rx="2"
        :fill="item.color"
      />
      <rect
        data-minimap-viewport
        v-bind="frame"
        rx="3"
        fill="none"
        class="stroke-foreground/70"
        stroke-width="1"
      />
    </svg>
  </button>
</template>
